title: Grateful Dead Live at Carter-Finley Stadium on 1990-07-10
lineage: Master DAT @ 48kHz > Panasonic SV3700  > 48kHz 16bit Wav > Sample Manager > 44.1kHz 24bit Wav > Wavelab 8.5 / Izotope Ozone 6.1 / MBit+ Dither > 44.1kHz 16bit wav; Recorded, Transferred and Digitally Mastered by Dan Tepper
source: Source: AKG 414-BTL (cardioid X-Y) > Neuman BS945i > Technics SVMD1 DAT;

ai_review.summary: Average soundboard capture of an odd, weather‑charged show where crowd energy makes it memorable
ai_review.review: The recording is a straightforward soundboard feed that lacks the ambient thunder, rain and stadium buzz that defined this night, so its technical quality is unremarkable.  However, reviewers note that the extreme heat, police presence and stormy conditions gave the concert an unforgettable atmosphere despite no specific musical highlights being mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4 stars) emphasizes atmospheric factors over performance; show is considered memorable but recording is plain, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard audio is clear but unremarkable; lacks crowd ambience, thunder and rain, making the listening experience feel isolated from the live energy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focus on external conditions (heat, rain, police) that shaped the concert's vibe.
